_note: Chapter 28 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The university set aside accommodation for the families of graduates in the northern dormitory.
ex.cn: 学校在北边那栋宿舍楼为毕业生家属腾出了住处。
ex.note: accommodation for sb. 为某人提供住处；accommodation to/for sth. 对…的适应

ex.en: She was a natural actress and needed almost no direction.
ex.cn: 她是个天生的演员，几乎不需要指导。
ex.note: actress / actor 女演员 / 男演员

ex.en: The graduation ceremony is a yearly affair that the whole campus looks forward to.
ex.cn: 毕业典礼是全校都盼着的年度盛事。
ex.note: a public/private affair 公私事务；in charge of affairs 掌管事务

ex.en: No two of us were alike, and each of us had changed in a different way.
ex.cn: 我们没有两个人是相同的，而且每个人改变的方式都不一样。
ex.note: alike 可作形容词和副词，置于 be 动词后：be alike 相同

ex.en: They were treated alike, although only one of them had come from a poor family.
ex.cn: 他们受到同等的对待，尽管其中一人出身贫困。
ex.note: alike 作副词时多置于 be 动词后、句末

ex.en: The old story about the basement amused the whole class.
ex.cn: 那个关于地下室的老故事把全班都逗乐了。
ex.note: amuse oneself 自我消遣；be amused at 对…感到好笑

ex.en: Anyone who wants a seat near the front should arrive before nine.
ex.cn: 凡是想在前排占到座位的人，都该在九点前到场。
ex.note: anyone but … 除了…谁；anyone else 还有别人

ex.en: April is usually the busiest month of the whole academic year.
ex.cn: 四月通常是一学年中最忙碌的月份。
ex.note: April 缩写为 Apr.，作介词时前面不加 the

ex.en: One aspect of the campus remained the same: the old stone gate.
ex.cn: 校园里有一处仍旧如旧：那道古老的石门。
ex.note: in every aspect 在各方面；an aspect of … …的一个方面

ex.en: The new library attracts thousands of students every year.
ex.cn: 这座新图书馆每年吸引成千上万的学生。
ex.note: attract attention 引起注意；attract sb. to sth. 把某人吸引到某处

ex.en: He took one step backward and nearly fell off the platform.
ex.cn: 他往后退了一步，差点从站台上摔下去。
ex.note: backward and forward 来来回回；backward-looking 守旧的

ex.en: They found the debris of four years in the basement of the old dormitory.
ex.cn: 他们在老宿舍的地下室里翻出了四年的残骸。
ex.note: in the basement 在地下室；a basement flat 地下室公寓

ex.en: We had to arrive before seven if we wanted a seat near the front.
ex.cn: 如果想坐在前排，我们得在七点前到。
ex.note: before 引导时间状语从句时，主句不用将来时

ex.en: She had never seen the open sea before that morning.
ex.cn: 那个早晨之前，她从没见过真正的大海。
ex.note: before 作副词表示“以前”，常放在句末

ex.en: Beyond the gate the whole district was being rebuilt.
ex.cn: 出了校门，整个片区都在重建。
ex.note: beyond doubt 毫无疑问；beyond the reach of 超出…够得着的范围

ex.en: He looked down at the bloody scratch on his knee and laughed it off.
ex.cn: 他低头看了看膝盖上那道血淋淋的划伤，却一笑了之。
ex.note: 多见于英式口语；a bloody nose 流血的鼻子

ex.en: At the bottom of a box they found an old computer mouse.
ex.cn: 在箱子底层，他们发现一只旧鼠标。
ex.note: at the bottom of 在…底部；the bottom line 底线

ex.en: The whole ceremony was broadcast live on the university channel.
ex.cn: 整场典礼由学校电视台现场直播。
ex.note: broadcast live 现场直播；broadcast by radio 用无线电广播

ex.en: A narrow path led them by the old mill and into the valley.
ex.cn: 一条小路把他们引过老磨坊，走进山谷。
ex.note: by accident 偶然；by the way 顺便说一句

ex.en: She sat by the window and watched the rain fall.
ex.cn: 她坐在窗边，看着雨落下来。
ex.note: by 表示“在…旁边”，也可作副词“在近旁”

ex.en: The hall has a seating capacity of eight hundred.
ex.cn: 这座礼堂能容纳八百人入座。
ex.note: in the capacity of 以…的身份；the capacity to do 做…的能力

ex.en: Every object in the room fell into one of three categories: keep, store, or throw away.
ex.cn: 房间里的每件东西都归入三类之一：留下、收起来、扔掉。
ex.note: fall into a category 归入某一类；a category of … …的一类

ex.en: They found the little town by chance during their first year.
ex.cn: 他们是在第一年偶然发现那座小镇的。
ex.note: by chance 偶然；take a chance 冒险一试

ex.en: A chance meeting on the platform turned into a lifelong friendship.
ex.cn: 站台上一场偶然的相遇，最后变成了一生的友谊。
ex.note: chance encounter 偶遇；a chance to do sth. 做某事的机会

ex.en: Every child in the neighbourhood came to watch the procession.
ex.cn: 街区里的每个孩子都跑来看队伍。
ex.note: children 复数；childhood 童年

ex.en: The chairman paused to clarify a point that several students had misunderstood.
ex.cn: 主席停下来，澄清了几个学生误解的地方。
ex.note: clarify sth. for sb. 向某人澄清某事

ex.en: They took the night coach to the mountain town.
ex.cn: 他们乘夜班长途汽车去了那座山城。
ex.note: a coach journey 长途汽车旅行；sports coach 教练

ex.en: She coached the runners for a week before the race.
ex.cn: 比赛前一周，她一直在指导那些跑步的人。
ex.note: coach sb. in sth. 在某方面辅导某人

ex.en: In his dark uniform the old officer looked more like a commander than a teacher.
ex.cn: 那位老军官穿着深色制服，看上去更像个指挥官，而不像老师。
ex.note: the commander-in-chief 总司令；a company commander 连长

ex.en: Sorting four years of study into boxes was a complicated business.
ex.cn: 把这四年的书本分装成箱是件麻烦事。
ex.note: a complicated process 复杂的过程；complicated for sb. 对某人来说很难

ex.en: He confessed that he had not yet finished the report.
ex.cn: 他承认报告还没写完。
ex.note: confess to doing sth. 承认做过某事；confess that … 承认……

ex.en: Four years of hard work constitute the better part of a young life.
ex.cn: 四年的苦读，构成了年轻人生命中最要紧的一段。
ex.note: constitute the majority 构成大多数

ex.en: The university holds a graduation convention every June.
ex.cn: 大学每年六月都要举行毕业典礼。
ex.note: national convention 全国代表大会；by convention 按照惯例

ex.en: An old couch with one leg missing stood by the window.
ex.cn: 窗边摆着一张缺了一条腿的旧沙发。
ex.note: couch potato 懒虫；a couch in the corner 角落里的沙发

ex.en: A small creature with a loud voice sat in the hollow of a tree.
ex.cn: 一只嗓门很大的小生灵蹲在树洞里。
ex.note: living creature 生物；a creature of habit 习惯的奴隶

ex.en: He opened the old jar out of curiosity, and regretted it at once.
ex.cn: 他出于好奇打开了那只旧罐子，立刻就后悔了。
ex.note: out of curiosity 出于好奇；arouse curiosity 引起好奇

ex.en: The exact date of the ceremony was printed on the banner.
ex.cn: 典礼的确切日期印在了横幅上。
ex.note: on the date of … 在…那一天；a date with sb. 与某人的约会

ex.en: The letter is dated the first of April.
ex.cn: 这封信上的日期是四月一日。
ex.note: date a document 在文件上注明日期；be dated … 注明日期为……

ex.en: A deed is what remains after all the words have been said.
ex.cn: 话说完之后留下来的，才是真正的行动。
ex.note: in word and deed 在言语和行动上；a legal deed 法律契约

ex.en: His departure from the town was marked by a small ceremony.
ex.cn: 他离开那座小镇时，举行了一场小小的仪式。
ex.note: a departure from sth. 背离某事；the departure lounge 候机厅

ex.en: She developed a habit of reading a few pages before she went to sleep.
ex.cn: 她养成了睡前读几页书的习惯。
ex.note: develop a habit 养成习惯；develop into 发展成

ex.en: The eight of them sat down to dinner at a restaurant near the station.
ex.cn: 八个人在车站附近的一家餐馆坐下来吃晚饭。
ex.note: have dinner 吃晚饭；a dinner party 晚宴

ex.en: He put an old disk into the machine, but nothing happened.
ex.cn: 他把一张旧磁盘放进机器里，却什么也没发生。
ex.note: hard disk 硬盘；floppy disk 软盘

ex.en: The smell was strong enough to drive a dog out of the room.
ex.cn: 那股味道强烈得足以把一条狗赶出房间。
ex.note: a dog's life 狗一样的生活；dog-eat-dog 狗咬狗

ex.en: She likes to draw portraits of her friends in the margins of her notebook.
ex.cn: 她喜欢在本子边角上画朋友的肖像。
ex.note: draw a conclusion 得出结论；draw attention to 引起对…的注意

ex.en: The whole district felt dynamic, with new towers rising everywhere.
ex.cn: 到处都在起新楼，整个片区都显得朝气蓬勃。
ex.note: a dynamic personality 充满活力的个性；a dynamic market 动态市场

ex.en: Anyone could see the effect of the rain on the field.
ex.cn: 谁都看得出那场雨把操场糟蹋成了什么样。
ex.note: have an effect on 对…有影响；in effect 实际上

ex.en: She sent me an email about the reunion on the first of July.
ex.cn: 她给我发了一封邮件，问七月初聚会的事。
ex.note: send / receive an email 发 / 收电子邮件

ex.en: We promised to email each other once a month.
ex.cn: 我们答应每个月互发一次邮件。
ex.note: email sb. 给某人发电子邮件

ex.en: Soon she was engaged in a long conversation about the future.
ex.cn: 很快她便投入了一场关于未来的长谈。
ex.note: be engaged in 从事于；engage sb. in sth. 使某人参与某事

ex.en: We are living in an era of rapid construction.
ex.cn: 我们正生活在一个高速建设的年代。
ex.note: a new era 一个新时代；the modern era 现代

ex.en: He remembered the exact spot where he had fallen off his bicycle.
ex.cn: 他记得自己当年摔下自行车的那个确切位置。
ex.note: the exact number 确切的数目；to be exact 确切地说

ex.en: The expectation in the hall was mixed with a little panic.
ex.cn: 礼堂里的期待里掺着一点恐慌。
ex.note: beyond expectations 出乎意料；meet expectations 达到预期

ex.en: "That is a fact," David said, and nobody argued with him.
ex.cn: “这是事实。”大卫说，没有人反驳他。
ex.note: in fact 事实上；the fact is that … 事实是……

ex.en: Her performance on the little stage was the most fascinating part of the evening.
ex.cn: 她在那座小舞台上的表演是那一晚最迷人的部分。
ex.note: fascinating 对…着迷；be fascinated by 被…深深吸引

ex.en: A wooden fence leaned against the slope of the hill.
ex.cn: 一道木栅栏歪歪斜斜地靠在山坡上。
ex.note: fence in / out 围住 / 把…排除在外；fence sth. off 隔开

ex.en: He has taken a job at a small firm in the city.
ex.cn: 他在城里那家小公司找到了一份工作。
ex.note: a law firm 律师事务所；a family firm 家族企业

ex.en: It was a firm plan, and nobody was allowed to change it.
ex.cn: 那是一个已定的方案，谁也不许更改。
ex.note: a firm decision 坚定的决定；firmly 坚决地

ex.en: He could not focus on the jokes; his mind was somewhere else.
ex.cn: 他没法把心思放在那些笑话上，脑子里想的是别的事。
ex.note: focus on 专注于；focus one's attention on 把注意力集中在

ex.en: The focus of the ceremony was the students crossing the stage.
ex.cn: 典礼的焦点，是那些走过主席台的学生。
ex.note: the focus of attention 注意力的焦点；a focal point 中心

ex.en: He found a sheet of formulae from their very first physics class.
ex.cn: 他找到了一张他们第一堂物理课的公式表。
ex.note: a chemical formula 化学式；the formula for success 成功的秘诀

ex.en: A frog sat in the hollow of the tree and watched them pass.
ex.cn: 一只青蛙蹲在树洞里，看着他们走过。
ex.note: a frog in the throat 喉咙发紧；a toad 蟾蜍

ex.en: The old gang sat on the floor in a circle and talked about the future.
ex.cn: 老伙计们围坐在地板上，谈论着将来。
ex.note: a gang of thieves 一伙窃贼；join a gang 加入一伙

ex.en: The media giants paid millions for the rights to the story.
ex.cn: 几家传媒巨头为买下这个故事的版权付了几百万。
ex.note: media giants 传媒巨头；an oil giant 石油巨头

ex.en: A giant new library was rising behind the old gym.
ex.cn: 旧体育馆后面正升起一座巨型新图书馆。
ex.note: a giant size 巨大的尺码；a giant step 巨大的一步

ex.en: A single simple rule governed the decision to move the ceremony indoors.
ex.cn: 典礼是否改到室内，由一条简单的规则决定。
ex.note: be governed by 受…支配；govern a country 治理国家

ex.en: Volunteers stood at the door to greet the families.
ex.cn: 志愿者站在门口迎接各家亲属。
ex.note: greet sb. with sth. 用某物迎接某人；greet sb. warmly 热情地招呼某人

ex.en: By nine o'clock, half the field was dry.
ex.cn: 到九点，操场上有一半已经干了。
ex.note: half of … …的一半；half the time 一半时间

ex.en: A field of hay lay between the mill and the river.
ex.cn: 磨坊与河之间躺着一片干草田。
ex.note: make hay 晒干草；a haystack 干草堆

ex.en: He never saw her without a book in her hand.
ex.cn: 他从未见过她手里不拿着书的样子。
ex.note: her 是宾格和物主代词；不要与 here（这里）混淆

ex.en: A frog sat in the hollow of an old tree and watched them pass.
ex.cn: 一只青蛙蹲在一棵老树的凹陷处，看着他们走过。
ex.note: a hollow voice 空洞的声音；hollow out 挖空

ex.en: The university provides housing for all its students.
ex.cn: 学校为所有学生提供住宿。
ex.note: public housing 公共住房；a housing policy 住房政策

ex.en: Mark is completely ignorant of art, and everybody knows it.
ex.cn: 马克对艺术一窍不通，这一点人人都知道。
ex.note: be ignorant of 不知道；ignorant of the facts 不了解事实

ex.en: A role can imprison you if you let it.
ex.cn: 一个角色如果由着你，就能把你囚住。
ex.note: be imprisoned in 被困在；imprison oneself 自我囚禁

ex.en: The chairs upstairs were inferior, but the basement had more history.
ex.cn: 楼上的椅子要差一些，但地下室里的东西更有年头。
ex.note: be inferior to 不如；inferior goods 次等品

ex.en: For instance, that new tower will be finished within the year.
ex.cn: 比如说，那座新楼一年之内就能完工。
ex.note: for instance 例如；an instance of sth. 某事的一个例子

ex.en: A loud noise interrupted the lecture half way through.
ex.cn: 一声巨响在讲座进行到一半时打断了它。
ex.note: interrupt sb. 打断某人；interrupt sb. with sth. 以某物打断某人

ex.en: She put a jar of her mother's sauce in the middle of the table.
ex.cn: 她把一罐她母亲做的酱放在桌子正中。
ex.note: a jar of jam 一罐果酱；a jar of honey 一罐蜂蜜

ex.en: The drama coach was a keen woman with a sharp eye for detail.
ex.cn: 那位戏剧指导是个眼光敏锐、热衷此道的女人。
ex.note: be keen on 热衷于；a keen sense of timing 精准的节奏感

ex.en: An old lady from the housing office pressed a paper flower into his hand.
ex.cn: 住房办公室的一位老妇人把一朵纸花塞进他手里。
ex.note: an old lady 一位老妇人；the lady of the house 女主人

ex.en: Mark was never lazy; he simply had too much energy to sit still.
ex.cn: 马克从不偷懒，他只是精力太多，坐不住。
ex.note: a lazy afternoon 懒洋洋的下午；lazy about 对…偷懒

ex.en: They let the ground-floor flat to two students for the summer.
ex.cn: 他们把底层公寓在夏天租给了两个学生。
ex.note: let sb. do 让某人做；let sth. to sb. 把某物租给某人

ex.en: The waiter brought a liter of tea and a pot of rice.
ex.cn: 服务员端来一升茶和一壶米饭。
ex.note: a liter of water 一升水；litres 是复数形式

ex.en: The loss would come later, in small pieces, and she knew it.
ex.cn: 失去会慢慢来，一次一小块，她心里清楚。
ex.note: a loss of … 丧失；a total loss 全部损失

ex.en: The crowd was mainly made up of parents and grandparents.
ex.cn: 人群主要由父母和祖父母组成。
ex.note: mainly 用于动词或形容词前，表示“主要地”

ex.en: A massive tent had been raised on the sports field.
ex.cn: 操场上搭起了一座巨大的帐篷。
ex.note: massive amounts of 大量的；on a massive scale 以巨大的规模

ex.en: They arranged to meet at the gate before the ceremony.
ex.cn: 他们约好典礼前在校门口碰面。
ex.note: meet a need 满足需要；meet sb. at the station 到车站接某人

ex.en: The annual sports meet was held on the last Friday of term.
ex.cn: 年度运动会在学期的最后一个星期五举行。
ex.note: the sports meet 运动会；a class meet 班会

ex.en: The old mill by the stream had been turned into a small museum.
ex.cn: 溪边那座老磨坊被改成了一座小博物馆。
ex.note: a paper mill 造纸厂；a rolling mill 轧钢机

ex.en: Afterwards there was a modest reception with tea and cakes.
ex.cn: 随后是一场简朴的茶点招待会。
ex.note: a modest house 简朴的房子；make a modest claim 提出适度的要求

ex.en: He found an old computer mouse at the bottom of a box.
ex.cn: 他在箱子底下找到一只旧鼠标。
ex.note: a field mouse 田鼠；like a mouse 像老鼠一样

ex.en: The national anthem was sung by the student choir.
ex.cn: 学生合唱团唱起了国歌。
ex.note: the national flag 国旗；national pride 民族自豪感

ex.en: He kept his voice calm and neutral, and the crowd grew calmer too.
ex.cn: 他的声音平静而中立，人群也随之平静下来。
ex.note: remain neutral 保持中立；a neutral tone 中立的语气

ex.en: They put the visiting families in the northern dormitory.
ex.cn: 他们把来访的家属安置在北边那栋宿舍楼。
ex.note: the northern provinces 北方各省；Northern Europe 北欧

ex.en: David sat in the third row and observed her quietly.
ex.cn: 大卫坐在第三排静静地观察她。
ex.note: observe sb. doing sth. 观察某人做某事；observe the rules 遵守规则

ex.en: We promised to meet here once a year.
ex.cn: 我们答应每年在这儿见一次面。
ex.note: once upon a time 很久很久以前；at once 立刻

ex.en: Once the rain stopped, the staff began to lay the wooden floor.
ex.cn: 雨一停，工作人员就开始铺木地板。
ex.note: once 作连词表示“一旦”，主句用一般将来时

ex.en: Something green had once been an organism living in that jar.
ex.cn: 那只罐子里曾经养过某种绿色的活物。
ex.note: a living organism 生物体；a simple organism 简单生物

ex.en: The forecast threatened a storm overnight.
ex.cn: 天气预报说夜里会有暴风雨。
ex.note: stay overnight 留宿过夜；an overnight train 通宵火车

ex.en: The review of her play in the campus paper was kind.
ex.cn: 校报上那篇评论她这部戏的文章写得很温和。
ex.note: a research paper 研究论文；on paper 纸面上

ex.en: The role required both patience and a sharp sense of timing.
ex.cn: 这个角色既需要耐心，也需要对节奏的精准把握。
ex.note: have patience with sb. 对某人耐心；with patience 耐心地

ex.en: Her performance in the last act brought the audience to its feet.
ex.cn: 她在最后一幕的表演让观众起立鼓掌。
ex.note: a performance of a play 戏剧演出；the car's performance 车的性能

ex.en: The piano was played live, and it suited the play perfectly.
ex.cn: 钢琴是现场弹奏的，与这出戏配合得天衣无缝。
ex.note: play the piano 弹钢琴；a piano piece 钢琴曲

ex.en: She played the lead in a student play last May.
ex.cn: 去年五月，她在一部学生话剧中担任主演。
ex.note: play a part 扮演角色；play the piano 弹钢琴

ex.en: The students put on a short play for their parents on the last night.
ex.cn: 最后一晚，学生们为父母演了一出短剧。
ex.note: a school play 校园戏剧；fair play 公平竞争

ex.en: The mill had once polluted the stream, but the water is clear now.
ex.cn: 那座磨坊从前污染过这条溪，可如今水已经清了。
ex.note: pollute the air / water 污染空气 / 水；be polluted by 被…污染

ex.en: The dinner was simple: fish, potatoes, greens and a large pot of tea.
ex.cn: 晚饭很简单：鱼、土豆、青菜，外加一大壶茶。
ex.note: hot potatoes 烫手的山芋；potato chips 薯片

ex.en: The president of the university shook the hand of every graduate.
ex.cn: 校长与每一位毕业生都握了手。
ex.note: the president of a company 公司总裁；the president of a country 国家元首

ex.en: The procedure was simple: names were read, students crossed the stage.
ex.cn: 流程很简单：念到名字，学生走过主席台。
ex.note: the standard procedure 标准程序；follow the procedure 遵循程序

ex.en: The officer wanted to protect the grass from being ruined.
ex.cn: 那位官员想保护草皮，不让它被糟蹋。
ex.note: protect sb. from sth. 保护某人免受某事；protect A from B 保护A免受B

ex.en: He would pursue his own work in the city and start a new life there.
ex.cn: 他会在城里从事自己的工作，在那里开始新的生活。
ex.note: pursue a career 追求事业；pursue happiness 追求幸福

ex.en: It had been rainy for three days, and the ground never dried.
ex.cn: 雨连下了三天，地面始终没干。
ex.note: a rainy season 多雨的季节；rainy days 阴雨天

ex.en: The bill was reasonable, so nobody argued about it.
ex.cn: 账单不算贵，所以没人争辩。
ex.note: a reasonable price 公道的价格；a reasonable request 合情合理的要求

ex.en: She had spent thirty years working with refugees from three countries.
ex.cn: 她花了三十年时间为来自三个国家的难民工作。
ex.note: a refugee camp 难民营；refugee status 难民身份

ex.en: He waved until the train was out of sight, and then watched the people who remained.
ex.cn: 他挥手，直到火车消失在视野里，然后看着留在原地的人。
ex.note: remain calm 保持冷静；it remains to be seen 仍有待观察

ex.en: They reserved a table at a restaurant near the station.
ex.cn: 他们在车站附近的一家餐馆订了一桌。
ex.note: reserve a seat 预订座位；reserve sth. for sb. 为某人保留某物

ex.en: The school keeps a large reserve of books for the examination period.
ex.cn: 学校为考试周储备了大量的书。
ex.note: a nature reserve 自然保护区；with reserve 矜持地

ex.en: The review of her play in the campus paper was surprisingly kind.
ex.cn: 校报上那篇评论她这部戏的文章，出人意料地温和。
ex.note: a book review 书评；review one's notes 复习笔记

ex.en: A role can imprison you if you let it.
ex.cn: 一个角色如果由着你，就能把你囚住。
ex.note: play the role of 扮演…角色；the role of … …的作用

ex.en: Leaving was a kind of sacrifice, and nobody said so out loud.
ex.cn: 离开是一种牺牲，只是没有人说出口。
ex.note: make a sacrifice 作出牺牲；at the cost of 以…为代价

ex.en: He sacrificed a comfortable job for the chance to work abroad.
ex.cn: 他牺牲了一份安稳的工作，只为换取出国工作的机会。
ex.note: sacrifice sth. for sth. 为…牺牲某物

ex.en: "That is not a saying," Sarah said. "It is your own."
ex.cn: “那不是谚语。”萨拉说，“那是你自己造的。”
ex.note: as the saying goes 正如俗话所说；a common saying 俗语

ex.en: The old letter was closed with a red wax seal.
ex.cn: 那封旧信是用一枚红色火漆印封的。
ex.note: a seal of approval 认可的印章；the seal of the office 官方印章

ex.en: They sealed the boxes carefully before the van came.
ex.cn: 他们把箱子仔细封好，然后货车才来。
ex.note: seal a deal 敲定一笔交易；seal sth. up 密封

ex.en: She is sensitive to every word spoken on the stage.
ex.cn: 她对舞台上的每一句话都很敏感。
ex.note: be sensitive to 对…敏感；sensitive skin 敏感性皮肤

ex.en: The part required a sharp sense of timing.
ex.cn: 那个角色需要对节奏有精准的把握。
ex.note: a sharp turn 急转弯；sharp pain 剧痛；sharp criticism 尖锐的批评

ex.en: The ceremony began at eight sharp, and nobody was late.
ex.cn: 典礼八点整开始，没有一个人迟到。
ex.note: eight sharp 八点整；turn sharply 急转

ex.en: He shrugged and walked away without another word.
ex.cn: 他耸了耸肩，一句话也没说就走了。
ex.note: shrug off 对…不予理会；shrug one's shoulders 耸肩

ex.en: His little sister was the first to sign the guest book.
ex.cn: 他的小妹妹是第一个在来宾簿上签名的人。
ex.note: an elder / younger sister 姐姐 / 妹妹；a sister company 姐妹公司

ex.en: Only a small number of guests came to the reception.
ex.cn: 只有少数客人来赴茶点招待会。
ex.note: a small amount of 少量的；in small print 用小字印的

ex.en: The solution was to lay a long wooden floor over the mud.
ex.cn: 解决办法是在泥地上铺一条长长的木地板。
ex.note: a solution to sth. 某问题的解决办法；a chemical solution 溶液

ex.en: The span of four years had changed them more than the buildings.
ex.cn: 四年的时光改变他们的，比改变那些建筑更多。
ex.note: a span of … …的一段时间；the time span 时间跨度

ex.en: The new bridge spans the whole valley in a single arch.
ex.cn: 这座新桥以一道拱跨过整条山谷。
ex.note: span the gap 跨越鸿沟；a life span 寿命

ex.en: Do not spoil the child by giving him everything he asks for.
ex.cn: 别宠坏孩子，他想要什么就给他什么。
ex.note: spoil the fun 扫兴；spoil the milk 使牛奶变质

ex.en: The station was full of families and bags.
ex.cn: 车站里堆满了人和行李。
ex.note: a railway station 火车站；a radio station 电台

ex.en: There is a small store at the corner of the campus.
ex.cn: 校园拐角处有一家小商店。
ex.note: a grocery store 杂货店；in store 有现货

ex.en: They stored the old furniture in boxes for the summer.
ex.cn: 他们把旧家具装进箱子，存放了一个夏天。
ex.note: store sth. away 储藏某物；a cold storage room 冷藏室

ex.en: He studied the faces of the audience without appearing to look at them.
ex.cn: 他端详着观众的脸，却让人看不出他在看。
ex.note: study hard 努力学习；study the problem 研究问题

ex.en: She spent four years of study in a small town by the sea.
ex.cn: 她在海边一座小城学习了四年。
ex.note: a study of sth. 对某事的研究；a quiet study 一间安静的书房

ex.en: The summer would pass, and the yearly reunion would come.
ex.cn: 夏天会过去，而每年一次的聚会终会到来。
ex.note: in the summer 在夏天；the summer holidays 暑假

ex.en: She was a survivor of the war herself, and she spoke without notes.
ex.cn: 她自己就是那场战争的幸存者，讲话时没有带讲稿。
ex.note: the sole survivor 唯一的幸存者；a survivor of cancer 癌症康复者

ex.en: She has a real talent for reading people.
ex.cn: 她在观察人心方面有一种真正的天赋。
ex.note: a talent for sth. 做某事的天赋；a talented student 有才华的学生

ex.en: She went north for a temporary job that lasted six months.
ex.cn: 她到北方去做了一份临时工作，干了六个月。
ex.note: temporary work 临时工作；a temporary measure 临时措施

ex.en: He was silent then, and looked out of the window for a long time.
ex.cn: 他那时没说话，久久地望着窗外。
ex.note: then and there 当场；even then 即使那样

ex.en: A storm was threatening the coast all night.
ex.cn: 整整一夜，一场风暴都在威胁着海岸。
ex.note: threaten to do sth. 威胁要做某事；be threatened with 受到…威胁

ex.en: He walked to the gate and waited there for the others.
ex.cn: 他走到校门口，在那里等着其他人。
ex.note: to the point of 到…的程度；give sth. to sb. 把某物给某人

ex.en: They took a coach to a small town in the western hills.
ex.cn: 他们搭长途汽车去了西部山区的一座小镇。
ex.note: go to town 去城里；the town centre 市中心

ex.en: Her voice began to tremble as she tried to say goodbye.
ex.cn: 她试着道别时，声音开始发颤。
ex.note: tremble with fear 因恐惧而颤抖；a trembling voice 发颤的声音

ex.en: They had walked that road twice a day for four years.
ex.cn: 四年来，他们每天都在那条路上走两趟。
ex.note: twice a day 每天两次；twice as many as 是…的两倍

ex.en: The officer in charge wore a dark uniform.
ex.cn: 负责的那位官员穿着一身深色制服。
ex.note: in uniform 穿制服；a school uniform 校服

ex.en: The students wore uniform grey coats for the ceremony.
ex.cn: 学生们为典礼穿上了统一的灰色外套。
ex.note: uniform standards 统一标准；uniform throughout 全程一致的

ex.en: Nobody knew who had been the last user of that old mouse.
ex.cn: 没有人知道那只旧鼠标最后是谁在用。
ex.note: a regular user 常规用户；the end user 最终用户

ex.en: A small fishing vessel was tied at the little dock.
ex.cn: 一艘小渔船系在小小的码头上。
ex.note: a blood vessel 血管；a cargo vessel 货轮

ex.en: He kept a small vocabulary of the words he had learned in four years.
ex.cn: 他把四年里学到的词记在一个小本子上。
ex.note: a large vocabulary 丰富的词汇量；build up one's vocabulary 扩大词汇量

ex.en: A wave of applause ran through the hall.
ex.cn: 一阵掌声在礼堂里荡开。
ex.note: a wave of 一种浪潮；a wave of the hand 挥手

ex.en: He waved until the carriage had gone out of sight.
ex.cn: 他一直挥手，直到那节车厢消失在视野里。
ex.note: wave sb. goodbye 挥手道别；flags waved in the wind 旗帜在风中飘扬

ex.en: They took a coach to a small town in the western hills.
ex.cn: 他们搭长途汽车去了西部山区的一座小镇。
ex.note: the western provinces 西部各省；Western culture 西方文化

ex.en: A widow who had worked with refugees for thirty years took the stage.
ex.cn: 一位与难民共事三十年的寡妇登上了台。
ex.note: a widow and her children 寡妇和她的孩子们；a young widow 年轻寡妇

ex.en: He read a few words aloud, and the room grew quiet.
ex.cn: 他念出几个词，屋里渐渐安静下来。
ex.note: in other words 换句话说；keep one's word 遵守诺言

ex.en: A yearly reunion in that little town became their tradition.
ex.cn: 每年在那座小镇聚一次，成了他们的传统。
ex.note: a yearly report 年度报告；yearly income 年收入
